text:
Opus made dice I actually want to eat. And did it for less 🎲😂

Claude Opus 5.5 vs ChatGPT-6 Astra. Same idea - gummy dice

I prefer Opus here: juicy colors, translucent material, and that soft, stretchy jelly feel. Astra’s version looks firmer, and the colors and highlights don’t grab me as much

Estimated API cost:
Opus - $16.50
Astra - $20.89

For me, Opus wins this round on both looks and price. Which ones would you squish? 👀
